field.name: force_method

label.de: Verfahren der Kraftverteilung auf die Verbindungsmittel

field.doc: 🔩 Method that distributes an eccentric in-plane shear over the fasteners of a bolt group (EN 1999-1-1 8.5): the elastic method (rigid plate, forces proportional to the distance from the centroid) or the instantaneous-centre method (ductile fasteners rotating about the instantaneous centre of rotation).

enum.name: FastenerForceMethod
enum.doc: 🔩 Distribution of an eccentric shear over a bolt group: elastic method or instantaneous-centre method.
